 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. São Paulo held their penultimate training session ahead of their match against Fluminense on Tuesday morning (17) at the Barra Funda training center. The Brazilian Championship Matchweek 35 fixture will kick off at 9:30 p.m. on Thursday (19) at MorumBIS.
 The day's news was the return of defensive midfielder Djhordney and midfielder Pedro Ferreira, who had been with Brazil's Under-20 national team in Belém, Pará. They stayed indoors at the training center for recovery work, having featured in Monday night's (16) 9–0 friendly win over Peru at Mangueirão. Pedro Ferreira started, while Djhordney came on during the match and provided an assist.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The São Paulo duo had also played for Brazil's Under-20s on Friday (13) in another friendly against Peru, which Brazil won 2–0, also at Mangueirão. On that occasion, Djhordney started and Pedro Ferreira came off the bench to take the corner that led to the opening goal.
 On the pitch, with a group of academy players from Cotia taking part, head coach Dorival Júnior led an 11-a-side session focused on defensive organization—Monday's (16) work had emphasized attacking movement. There were also positional tactical drills and repeated set-piece practice.
 After the team session, left-back Nicolas took to the pitch for the first time since undergoing surgery to repair the meniscus in his left knee on September 9. The youngster ran on the grass under the supervision of the physiotherapists and was joined by right-back Buta, who is recovering from arthroscopic surgery on his right knee and also completed an exercise circuit on the pitch.
 On Wednesday afternoon (18), the Tricolor will wrap up their preparations for the match with another session at the Barra Funda training center.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bobadilla starts in Paraguay win 
 Defensive midfielder Bobadilla played the full 90 minutes in Paraguay's 2–1 friendly win over Japan in Singapore on Tuesday (17). He had also come off the bench in the 4–1 win over Singapore last Friday (13). The São Paulo player now returns to Brazil, with his arrival scheduled for late Wednesday afternoon (18).
